Fixed Specification:
Function: calculateTicketCompletionTimes
Purpose: To calculate the time at which each person finishes purchasing their ticket at a ticket booth.
Signature: calculateTicketCompletionTimes(int N, int A, int[] T)
Input: 
  - N: An integer representing the number of people arriving at the ticket booth.
  - A: An integer representing the time in seconds it takes for one person to purchase a ticket.
  - T: An array of integers of size N, where T[i] represents the time in seconds from now when the i-th person arrives at the ticket booth.
Output: 
  - An array of integers where each element represents the time in seconds from now when the corresponding person finishes purchasing their ticket.
Behavior:
  1. Initialize an array result of size N to store completion times.
  2. Set the initial completion time to 0.
  3. Iterate over each person i from 0 to N-1:
     a. If the current completion time is less than T[i], set the completion time to T[i].
     b. Add A to the current completion time to account for the ticket purchase.
     c. Store the updated completion time in result[i].
  4. Return the result array containing the completion times for each person.
